breakdown.description: The `turbulenceProperties` dictionary specifies both `simulationType LES` and a `RAS` sub-dictionary. A simulation can be either LES or RANS, but not both simultaneously in this manner.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The generated `constant/turbulenceProperties` dictionary contains the exact error described: it specifies `simulationType LES` at the top level, but also includes a `RAS` sub-dictionary. This is a conflicting and invalid configuration in OpenFOAM, as a simulation cannot be set to LES mode and simultaneously define a RANS model in this way. The Agent repeated the user's incorrect instruction instead of correcting it to a valid hybrid model specification (e.g., using a DES model under `simulationType RAS`).
